title: Opposite coherence for join-slice and comma-cone comparisons
statement:
Use simplicial sets, quasicategories, internal functor objects and coherent comma cones from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. For a simplicial set $K$ define $K^{\mathrm{op}}_m=K_m$ with the operator of $\alpha:[r]\to[m]$ given by the operator of $\alpha^\vee(i)=m-\alpha(r-i)$ on $K$. For a simplicial map $f$, $f^{\mathrm{op}}$ has the same degreewise components. Let $Y$ be a small simplicial set, $C$ a quasicategory and $d:Y\to C$ a diagram. Put $Q=C_{/d}$ with its left join-slice construction from [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration], and $V=(\Delta_Y\downarrow d)$ with its coherent comma construction. Put $a=d^{\mathrm{op}}:Y^{\mathrm{op}}\to C^{\mathrm{op}}$. Then $C^{\mathrm{op}}$ is a quasicategory, and the right join slice $J_a$, coherent cocone category $P_a$ and fat-join comparison $r_a:J_a\to P_a$ are those of [lem-coef-join-slice-cocone-comparison]. There are natural simplicial isomorphisms over $C^{\mathrm{op}}$
$$R:Q^{\mathrm{op}}\xrightarrow{\cong}J_a,\qquad S:V^{\mathrm{op}}\xrightarrow{\cong}P_a.$$
In degree $m$, $R$ takes $H:\Delta^m\star Y\to C$ to $H^{\mathrm{op}}$ precomposed with the ordered-block reversal $Y^{\mathrm{op}}\star\Delta^m\cong(\Delta^m\star Y)^{\mathrm{op}}$; the parameter simplex is identified with $(\Delta^m)^{\mathrm{op}}$ by $i\mapsto m-i$. For $S$, represent a comma simplex by an apex map $x:\Delta^m\to C$ and a map $h:Y\times\Delta^m\times\Delta^1\to C$ with $h(y,t,0)=x(t)$ and $h(y,t,1)=d(y)$. Its image is obtained by taking opposites, reversing the parameter simplex and the interval, so that the resulting cocone starts at $a$ and ends at the constant diagram at the reversed apex. Both isomorphisms commute with all simplex operators and with restriction in $Y$ and postcomposition in $C$.

These isomorphisms identify the specified comparison cones, not just their apices. Explicitly, for every vertex $\ell:\Delta^0\star Y\to C$ of $Q$, the vertex $S_0^{-1}(r_{a,0}(R_0(\ell)))$ of $V$ is exactly $\ell$ precomposed with the fat left-cone collapse
$$T_Y=\Delta^0\amalg_{Y\times\{0\}}(Y\times\Delta^1)\longrightarrow\Delta^0\star Y$$
of [lem-coef-infinity-join-cone-calculus]. Here the equality is under the defining equality of the degree-zero sets of a simplicial set and its opposite. It fixes the entire boundary diagram and the cone vertex. All assertions allow $Y=\varnothing$.

source.place: Riehl–Verity, Definition 2.1.14 (simplicial opposite), Definitions 3.2.4–3.2.5 and Example 3.2.6 (join/comma cones), and the cone in (6.1.1), published pp. 680, 684–685 and 707. Agent refinement: explicit opposite isomorphisms and compatibility with the prescribed fat-join comparison of the existing DAG nodes. Author-hosted PDF read in the retained sandbox; archival copy WANTED. No Stacks tag states this simplicial comparison.

mathlib_searches.verdict: No match: ordinary-category Join.opEquiv is not a simplicial-set join/comma comparison. Read Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Join/Opposites.lean:14–49 and 87–144. Read AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialSet/Op.lean:14–26,39–92, SimplexCategory/Rev.lean:25–84, SimplicialObject/Op.lean:34–92 and SimplicialSet/Monoidal.lean:245–265: these give reversal, products and involutivity, but no join-slice/comma isomorphisms or identification of the fat-cone comparison. The StrictSegal hits assume a strict Segal simplicial set and concern ordinary pointwise Kan extensions, not arbitrary quasicategories.

from.place: Proof paragraph 2, inverse-limit mapping-space calculation: mapping out of the small free-diagram colimit, without using space-valued straightening or model rectification. Technical recognition of the explicitly constructed coherent cone via its enriched join weight. Opposite join/comma comparison and identity of the actual fat-cone image, extracted from the recognition lemma’s former final step.
